scripts.dev:all: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web,admin -c cyan,magenta,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:admin"
scripts.test:all: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web,admin,packages -c cyan,magenta,green,blue "bun run test:api" "bun run test:web" "bun run test:admin" "bun run test:packages"
scripts.test:coverage: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web,admin,packages -c cyan,magenta,green,blue "bun run --cwd apps/api test:coverage" "bun run --cwd apps/web test:coverage" "bun run --cwd apps/admin test:coverage" "bun run --cwd packages/frontend-shared test:coverage"
scripts.test:e2e:all: bun run test:e2e:web && bun run test:e2e:admin
scripts.lint:strict: bun run --cwd apps/web lint:strict && bun run --cwd apps/admin lint:strict
scripts.test:ci: bun run db:check && bun run audit:dependencies && bun run check:workflow-actions && bun run check:architecture && bun run typecheck:all && bun run lint:strict && bun run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck:all: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:api && bun run typecheck:web && bun run typecheck:admin && bun run typecheck:test-scripts
